headline: EPS rises on the year but falls from last quarter
summary_short: Quarterly EPS was ¥25.66 versus ¥20.73 a year ago, up 23.8%, and down 38.8% from ¥41.93 in the prior quarter.
summary_long: Earnings per share of ¥25.66 compares with ¥20.73 in the same quarter a year earlier and ¥41.93 last quarter. These are the only verified figures on file; a web search found only first-half results, so revenue, operating profit and drivers are not reported.
